page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is configured with 8 GB of system memory, yielding 4 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates a single NVIDIA P4 GPU equipped with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large offers an entry-level GPU hardware profile, combining a low vCPU and memory footprint with dedicated hardware acceleration. This resource density makes it suitable for lightweight GPU-accelerated workloads such as small-scale AI inference, video transcoding, and basic parallel computing tasks rather than high-throughput deep learning training.
